decision.rationale: equivalence and non-inferiority are not the primary decision for this template

exclusion_rules: exclude only a predeclared infrastructure failure independent of treatment outcome
retain every exclusion row and reason in the raw records
no reruns: a failed attempt is retained under a new session id and never overwritten
inclusion_rules: retain and classify every randomized assignment
include a started session unless a predeclared infrastructure rule applies
a session's outcome is only its retained held-out evidence (28 of 32 oracle successes); an agent process that exits nonzero within budget is a failed session, not an exclusion

rule.source: heldout/heldout-evidence.json per session (controller-run, oracle as the held-out scorer)

power.assumption_note: control_probability 0.40 is the pre-registration ASSUMPTION carried from cse-causal-study-v1; this pilot protocol exists to REPLACE it with pilot-only control success (CSE-8). Pilot rows are calibration inputs only and never enter a confirmatory estimate (STA-3). 6 sessions per arm is below the CSE-8 floor of 10 by design (ADR-66).

primary_estimand.population: autonomous coding-agent sessions on the frozen task band

randomization.plan: sealed balanced plan over temporal blocks (tools/pilot_assignments.py); one typed_dataflow and one monolithic assignment per block
randomization.seed: controller-private 256-bit seed under ~/aisle-private/freeze/cse-causal-study-pilot-v8/ (never written into any artifact); the ledger records its commitment
